prepublicationFacts.text: Jonesboro ISD's May 30, 2026 school announcement describes the Lady Eagles as UIL 1A state champions for a third consecutive season, specifically 2024, 2025 and 2026.
UIL's 2025–26 tournament team sheet names head coach James Turner and assistants Keirsten Seahorn and Matt Dossey and lists the team as the Eagles in black, gold and white.
The 2025–26 UIL tournament team-sheet record is 23–9–1; it was submitted for the state tournament and must not be described as a confirmed final post-championship total.
The 2026 UIL 1A championship class is historical: the original *2026–27 softball alignment* places Jonesboro in the Conference 2A source document, District 26, Region IV.
The Jonesboro ISD June 29, 2026 announcement separately recognizes Texas High School Coaches Association 1A Super Elite awards; those are not automatically UIL state all-tournament awards.

identityConflicts: Jonesboro, Texas in Coryell County is NOT Jonesboro, Arkansas; reject Jonesboro AR municipal youth softball field and schedules.
The 2026 1A state-title class differs from Jonesboro's 2026–27 softball-alignment listing of 2A; do not relabel historic 1A trophies.

programs.identity: Santa Gertrudis Academy High School Lady Lions

prepublicationFacts.text: The 2026 UIL state-tournament entry calls the team 'Santa Gertrudis Academy' Lady Lions, coach Thomas De Los Santos and assistants Daniel Fernandez, Kennedy Silva and Amanda Sanchez.
UIL's tournament sheet lists six state appearances: 2013, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2023 and 2026; the 2018 entry is marked as an older championship year and 2026 is the new Division II title.
The 2025–26 UIL team-sheet record is 40–4 at submission; it may have a different postfinal total and must be attributed as a historical tournament snapshot.

Santa Gertrudis ISD's *current school-managed coaching directory* explicitly identifies Thomas De Los Santos as Girls Athletic Coordinator, Head Volleyball and Head Softball, distinct from the UIL's historical 2026 roster.

The official school identity lists Santa Gertrudis Academy High at 1055 West Santa Gertrudis Street on the Texas A&M University–Kingsville campus in Poteet Hall; that campus address is NOT the home softball-field address.
The official 2026–27 UIL softball alignment abbreviates the campus 'Santa Gertrudis Acad' in 3A District 30 Region IV; retain official source alias mapping with its full school name.

identityConflicts: Santa Gertrudis Academy High is in Kingsville and is not the Texas A&M University–Kingsville NCAA/NJCAA softball team, despite sharing campus surroundings.
Campus academic building at 1055 West Santa Gertrudis is not a proven girls varsity softball diamond entrance.
The UIL archive uses full 'Santa Gertrudis Academy', current district list abbreviates 'Santa Gertrudis Acad'.

prepublicationFacts.text: The UIL 2026 4A-DI champion Bullard tournament sheet names Julie Murry as head coach with Brett Murry, Danielle Hudspeth and Callie Bailey assisting in the archived 2025–26 season.

The 2026 championship is Bullard's first marked UIL state softball title within this tournament-appearance list; do not infer that the school's wider athletics department never won other sport titles.

Bullard ISD's school-operated Panther Sports Net reports that home softball-field contests have live video available through its Hudl service; this does not grant TexasDefined streaming/media republication rights.

Bullard's sports-media page quotes a particular 2026 subscription offer and explains varsity district and postseason audio coverage, but prices and availability are not permanent and must be reviewed before a visitor guide.
